youtube.description: In September 1752, millions of people in Britain went to bed on the 2nd and woke up on the 14th. Eleven days, gone, by law. Why? Protestant Britain had refused the pope's new calendar for 170 years, so by 1752 it was eleven days behind and those days had to be deleted. Russia waited even longer, until 1918, which is why the October Revolution happened in November. Full episode on the channel. #Shorts #history #calendar #leapyear #thehiddenwhy
